description: ID single, wages + interest, federal standard deduction, 5.3% above zero-rate amount
ID joint, both 65+: federal standard deduction with age add-ons plus the conformed federal senior deduction, partly phased out
working: ID AGI = 30,000 + 40,000 + 10,000 + 100,000 = 180,000 (no general Idaho capital-gains deduction). Standard deduction = federal 32,200 + 2 x 1,650 = 35,500. Senior deduction (HB 559 conformity to IRC 151(d)(5)(C)): 2 x 6,000 = 12,000 less 6% per eligible person of MAGI over 150,000 = 2 x 6% x 30,000 = 3,600 -> 8,400. Taxable 180,000 - 35,500 - 8,400 = 136,100. Tax: 5.3% x (136,100 - 9,622) = 5.3% x 126,478 = 6,703.33 -> 6,703.
